rules.statement: Under the Dutch system, a sale of land had to be carried out in the presence of the Court. However, under our Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, no sale, purchase, transfer, &c, of land or other immovable property shall be of force or avail in law unless executed before a notary and witnesses.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Dutch system it is said the sale of land had to be carried out in the presence of the Court, but under our Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, for the Prevention of Frauds and Perjuries, it is enacted by section 2 that no sale, purchase, transfer, &c, of land or other immovable property shall be of force or avail in law unless executed before a notary and witnesses."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, for the Prevention of Frauds and Perjuries, section 2
